items.source: Returns the ProjectionInformation for the given projection type.
items.translation: 返回给定投影类型的ProjectionInformation。

items.source: Creates a projection to the given type for the given nullable source.
items.translation: 为给定的可空源创建到指定类型的投影。

items.source: Creates a projection instance for the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型创建投影实例。

items.source: projectionType - the type to create, must not be null.
items.translation: projectionType - 要创建的投影类型，不能为 null。

items.source:
A factory to create projecting instances for other objects usually used to allow easy creation of representation
projections to define which properties of a domain objects shall be exported in which way.
items.translation: 工厂用于为其他对象创建投影实例，通常用于方便地定义表示投影，以指定域对象的哪些属性应以何种方式导出。

items.source: Creates a projection of the given type for the given source object.
items.translation: 为给定的源对象创建指定类型的投影。

items.source:
Creates a projection of the given type for the given source object. The individual mapping strategy is defined by
the implementations.
items.translation: 为给定的源对象创建指定类型的投影。具体的映射策略由实现定义。

items.source: source - the object to create a projection for, must not be null.
items.translation: source - 用于创建投影的对象，不能为 null。
